content:
Get ready to celebrate Canada Day the right way! 🇨🇦🎶
DJ John Main is bringing the high-energy vibes and crystal-clear sound straight to the Ethelbert Curling Rink for a special Canada Day bash. Whether you’re here for the classic rock anthems, 80s throwbacks, or just want to grab the mic and belt out your favourite country tune, this is the event you don’t want to miss.
What to expect:
🎤 Karaoke & Live Singers: Live singers will perform off and on throughout the afternoon, followed by our professional karaoke setup in the evening. Ready to shine? Grab the mic!
🎧 Curated Playlist: From hard rock and metal to classic country and everything in between, the music will keep the energy high all day long.
🍺 Beer Gardens & Tent: Enjoy a cold drink under our tent set up right in front of the curling rink.
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family Fun All Afternoon: The grounds around the rink will be packed with activities! Kids games, baseball, petting zoo, museum tours, bread baking, scavenger hunts, horseshoes, and more.
🤝 Community Vibe: This is more than just a party—it’s a chance to connect with neighbours, celebrate our local spirit, and kick off the summer right here in the Parkland region.
📍 Where: Ethelbert Curling Rink, Ethelbert, MB
📅 When: Canada Day, July 1st
⏰ Time: Doors open at 12:00 PM | Opening ceremony at 1:00 PM (Beer gardens open immediately after)
Bring your family, your friends, and your appetite for fun. Let’s make this Canada Day one for the books!

content:
DJ John Main started “Karaoke with John” in 2012 in Midwestern Ontario. Over the years, John has hosted several memorable Karaoke nights in the town of Palmerston and a Valentine’s Dance in Walton. He also provided a Music team for the Brussels Mennonite Fellowship Community Church.
Following a relocation to Manitoba in the spring of 2024, we resumed hosting karaoke events, including highly successful nights at the Ethelbert Curling Club. As these events grew in popularity, we began receiving numerous requests to provide comprehensive DJ services for weddings, socials, and buck-and-does. To better reflect this expanded range of full-service entertainment options, “Karaoke with John” was officially rebranded as Maintec Entertainment.
